semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in test equipment and probes essential for measuring electrical characteristics in semiconductor components.
summary: NPS provides high-performance four-prong probes for measuring the resistivity of conductors and other electrical characteristics. Their product offerings include specialized probes such as the PicoProbe ultra-low input capacitance FET probe, designed to meet the demands of advanced electronic component testing.
capabilities: PicoProbe ultra-low input capacitance FET probes
